udesc:hero_nadia.en: Timekeeper of the Sun Barque, who counts the hours of the night. **Orders**, **Night-Eye**; **The Gate of Hours:** once per battle you choose the order of activations for the round. **Weakness:** she barely fights.

udesc:hero_khaled.en: Captain of the Barge of Set's Spear, survivor of two of Apep's nights. **Orders**, **River-Swift**; **The Prow:** Spearmen of Set within 6" get +1 to shoot at monsters. **Weakness:** −1" in sand.

udesc:channel_crews.en: Diggers of Yu's canals. **Engineer**, **Digs Trenches**; their trench fills with water and gives monsters −1" Move. **Weakness:** one Wound.

udesc:boat_scouts.en: River scouts in light boats. **Scout**, **River-Swift**. **Weakness:** no Ambush on land.

udesc:poison_physicians.en: Physicians who heal the land and people poisoned by Xiangliu's blood. **Healer**; they neutralise poison within 6". **Weakness:** they barely fight.

udesc:dike_shieldbearers.en: Heavy infantry standing on the dikes. **Shield**, **Shield Wall**; they do not fall back at the edge of water terrain. **Weakness:** slow (4").

udesc:pump_armor.en: Heavy infantry armed with steam pumps: they knock monsters down with jets of water. **Steam**; the jet **pins**. **Weakness:** −1 Power in a dry scenario.

udesc:tripod_cannon.en: A cannon in the shape of a bronze tripod, engraved with the weak spots of monsters. **Vehicle**, **Finds the Weak Spot**. **Weakness:** slow (4").

udesc:sluice_fortress.en: A canal-sluice fortress that can let the water loose. **Walking Fortress**, **Flood:** once per battle it fills a 6" strip with water (hard going). **Weakness:** slow.

udesc:hero_lin.en: A canal engineer who knows every drawing on the Nine Tripods by heart. **Engineer**, **Finds the Weak Spot** (18"); **Nine Tripods:** a marked monster's "Regrowth" does not work this round. **Weakness:** he barely fights.

udesc:hero_wei.en: Captain of the Xiangliu Hunter-Barge. **Orders**, **River-Swift**; **Nine Heads:** allies within 6" get +1 Attack against a many-headed monster. **Weakness:** −1 Nerve on land.

udesc:island_riflemen.en: Riflemen of the coastal villages. **Fires on the Move**. **Weakness:** light armour.

udesc:oni_breakers.en: Trained for melee with oni, using a weapon like the oni's own — the iron club. **Monster-Hunter**. **Weakness:** slow.

udesc:mountain_herbalists.en: Herbalists of the mountain villages. **Healer**; **Peach Leaf:** they neutralise poison within 3". **Weakness:** they barely fight.

udesc:karakuri_makers.en: Masters of mechanical puppets. **Engineer**, **Repair:** a karakuri model within 3" regains 1 wound. **Weakness:** middling fighters.

udesc:kite_battery.en: Huge kites that carry riflemen up into the sky. **Flight**; they shoot from above. **Weakness:** cannot fly in a windless scenario.

udesc:oni_island_ship.en: A wheeled ship-fortress built for landing on the oni's island. **Walking Fortress**, **Landing**. **Weakness:** slow in the mountains.

udesc:hero_hana.en: A master of the bow-cannons, commander of Hidesato's Archers. **Third Arrow**, **Giant-Hunter**; **The Spittle-Tipped Arrow:** once per battle a shot ignores armour. **Weakness:** weak in melee.

udesc:hero_kentaro.en: A commander raised on the tale of Momotarō, attended by a dog, a monkey and a pheasant. **Orders**; **The Three Companions:** sees ambushers within 12" and climbs cliffs. **Weakness:** light armour.

udesc:stepwell_builders.en: Builders of stepwells: they build water and shelter beneath the ground. **Engineer**, **Digs Trenches**. **Weakness:** one Wound.

udesc:night_physicians.en: Physicians who heal those harmed by the chill of the bhuta. **Healer**; they lift Fear effects within 3". **Weakness:** they barely fight.

udesc:riddle_solvers.en: Keepers of the tales of Vikram: they know when to speak and when to stay silent. **Scout**, **Ambush**; **The Right Answer:** they automatically pass Fear tests against ghosts and monsters. **Weakness:** light armour.

udesc:lantern_wall.en: Heavy infantry with lanterns fixed to their shields: they hold back the bhuta with light. **Shield**, **Shield Wall**, **Beacon**. **Weakness:** slow (4").

udesc:vikram_guard.en: The elite of the Night Watch, sworn to patience. **Shield**, **Fearless**; **Patience:** they do not attack in the first round — from the second, +1 Melee. **Weakness:** expensive.

udesc:monsoon_crawler.en: A high-wheeled armour-crawler that crosses the monsoon mud. **Vehicle**; no penalty in mud. **Weakness:** slow in the mountains.

udesc:night_fortress.en: A walking fortress lit by hundreds of lanterns. **Walking Fortress**, **Beacon**; in a night scenario bhuta within 12" get −1 Nerve. **Weakness:** slow.

udesc:hero_anaya.en: Captain of the Night Watch, who knows the tale of Vikram by heart — the only one the vetala will speak to. **Orders**, **Night-Eye**; **The Vetala's Question:** once per battle one enemy unit cannot act this round (Nerve test). **Weakness:** light armour.

udesc:hero_sunil.en: Designer of the Lantern Wagon. **Engineer**, **Repair**; **A New Lantern:** once per battle a vehicle or fortification within 12" regains 2 wounds. **Weakness:** he barely fights.

udesc:mangrove_scouts.en: Scouts of the mangrove channels, in boats. **Scout**, **River-Swift**; they spot the spawn of Ninki Nanka from afar. **Weakness:** one Wound.

udesc:river_riflemen.en: Riflemen of the harbours and rivers. **Fires on the Move**. **Weakness:** light armour.

udesc:herb_healers.en: Healers who cure swamp fever and poison. **Healer**; they neutralise poison within 3". **Weakness:** they barely fight.

udesc:web_wall.en: Heavy infantry with shields strung with steel net. **Shield**, **Shield Wall**; the spear **Entangles**. **Weakness:** slow (4").

udesc:forge_guard.en: The city's smiths with steam hammers. **Steam**; **Armour-Breaker**. **Weakness:** poor shots.

udesc:spider_walker.en: An eight-legged walker built after the tales of Anansi, which walks on walls and webs. **Forged**, **Cliff-Climber**; **The Web:** a model it hits gets −2" Move next round. **Weakness:** Fears Fire.

udesc:harbor_fortress.en: A harbour battery that moves along the shore. **Walking Fortress**, **River-Swift**. **Weakness:** slow on high ground.

udesc:hero_adjoa.en: An engineer from a family of storytellers: she knows how to build webs — and every one of her grandmother's tales word for word. **Engineer**; **The Web:** once per battle she stops a Tier IV–V model within 12" for one round; **The Tale:** allies within 6" regain their nerve. **Weakness:** she barely fights.

udesc:hero_kwame.en: Captain of the harbour guard, who has lived through two risings of Ninki Nanka. **Orders**, **River-Swift**; **Don't Look at It:** allies within 6" take monster Fear tests at +2. **Weakness:** light armour.

udesc:timber_cruisers.en: Timber surveyors who know every trail and the tracks of every "fearsome critter". **Scout**, **Ambush**. **Weakness:** one Wound.

udesc:camp_doctors.en: Camp doctors of the lumberjacks and railwaymen. **Healer**. **Weakness:** they barely fight.

udesc:hodag_trappers.en: Trappers of the hodag and other forest monsters. **Monster-Hunter**; the gun **Entangles**. **Weakness:** slow.

udesc:rail_guard.en: Heavy infantry guarding the railway, with shields of rail steel. **Shield**, **Shield Wall**, **On Rails**. **Weakness:** slow (4").

udesc:river_drivers.en: Log drivers on the river, with steam hook-poles. **Steam**, **River-Swift**; the pole is a **Grab**. **Weakness:** poor shots.

udesc:blue_ox.en: A steam ox forged after the blue ox of the Paul Bunyan tales. **Forged**, **Fearless**; **Fells Trees:** it knocks down trees in its path and makes cover. **Weakness:** turns badly (−1 Armour against attacks from behind).

udesc:logging_camp.en: A logging camp, with sawmill and cookhouse, on steam runners. **Walking Fortress**, **Supply**. **Weakness:** Fears Fire.

udesc:hero_clara.en: Leader of the Hammer Gang, whose grandfather worked beside John Henry. **Fearless**, **Engineer**; **The Hammer Song:** allies within 6" dig tunnels and trenches twice as fast. **Weakness:** a poor shot.

udesc:hero_big_ole.en: A huge blacksmith and camp boss who bears the name of the smith of the lumberjack tales. **Orders**, **Repair**; **The Horseshoe:** once per battle a vehicle within 3" regains 2 wounds. **Weakness:** slow (5").

udesc:tlaloc_shields.en: **Shield Wall**; while guarding the ring of fire (a line of torches) they need no Fear test. Macuahuitl — a wooden sword edged with stone blades (2 Attacks). **Weakness:** slow.

udesc:mictlan_stormers.en: **They climb cliffs**; atlatl (12", Power 3) and macuahuitl (2 Attacks). They move through chasms and up stairs with no height penalty. **Weakness:** middling armour.

udesc:valley_healers.en: Healers of the lake valley, skilled with herbs and the steam bath. **Healer**. **Weakness:** they barely fight.

udesc:chinampa_builders.en: Builders of the floating gardens — the chinampas: they build land on the water. **Engineer**, **Digs Trenches**; **Chinampa:** once per battle they make a 3" strip of water passable. **Weakness:** middling fighters.

udesc:new_fire_gunners.en: Heavy infantry who fill the sky with lead on the night of the New Fire. **Shield**, **Sky-Breaker**; their fire **pins**. **Weakness:** slow.

udesc:star_cannon.en: A sky-pointed steam cannon against the tzitzimime. **Vehicle**, **Sky-Breaker**. **Weakness:** −1 to shoot at ground targets.

udesc:causeway_fortress.en: A fortress of the lake causeways, which moves along with its causeway. **Walking Fortress**; no penalty in water terrain. **Weakness:** slow.

udesc:hero_citlali.en: An astronomer-engineer; her name means "star" in Nahuatl. **Sky-Breaker**, **Night-Eye**; **Star Chart:** she sees winged and ambushing enemies within 18", and allies get +1 to shoot at them. **Weakness:** she barely fights.

udesc:hero_cuauhtli.en: Captain of the Sky-Watchers' guard, who has lived through two nights of the New Fire. **Orders**; **Ring of Fire:** once per battle allies within 6" strike first against a winged charge. **Weakness:** light armour.

udesc:river_nurses.en: Nurses who travel from village to village in a hospital boat. **Healer**, **River-Swift**. **Weakness:** they barely fight.

udesc:stilt_builders.en: Builders of houses and jetties on stilts. **Engineer**; **Stilts:** they build cover on water terrain. **Weakness:** middling fighters.

udesc:canopy_marksmen.en: Marksmen who shoot from the treetops. **Cliff-Climber**, **From the Heights**, **Ambush**. **Weakness:** weak in melee.

udesc:river_shieldbearers.en: Defenders of the jetties with heavy shields. **Shield**, **Shield Wall**, **River-Swift**. **Weakness:** slow (4").

udesc:boiuna_harpooners.en: Hunters of the great black river serpent. **Monster-Hunter**, **River-Swift**; the harpoon is a **Chain**. **Weakness:** poor shots.

udesc:amphibian_crawler.en: A steam amphibian that climbs out of the river onto the bank. **Vehicle**, **River-Swift**. **Weakness:** trees stop it in the forest (−2").

udesc:floating_fort.en: A river fortress on rafts of wood and iron. **Walking Fortress**, **River-Swift**; it cannot go onto land. **Weakness:** water only.

udesc:hero_lucia.en: A river pilot who knows the line between the black and white waters with her eyes shut. **Orders**, **River-Swift**, **Wayfinder**; **Meeting of the Waters:** allied boats and vehicles within 6" get +2" Move. **Weakness:** light armour.

udesc:hero_tiago.en: A veteran of the Mapinguari Hunters, who knows the forest's silence by the roar. **Giant-Hunter**, **Ambush**; **Knowing the Roar:** automatically passes Fear tests. **Weakness:** no armour.

udesc:mountain_healers.en: Healers of the high mountains, who treat altitude sickness and frostbite. **Healer**, **Mountain Folk**. **Weakness:** they barely fight.

udesc:condor_watchers.en: Watchers of the highest ridges, the first to see the stone giants move. **Scout**, **From the Heights**, **Cliff-Climber**. **Weakness:** light armour.

udesc:terrace_builders.en: Builders of mountain terraces: they turn a slope into steps. **Engineer**, **Digs Trenches**; twice as fast at building cover on a slope. **Weakness:** middling fighters.

udesc:drystone_guard.en: Heavy infantry with shields of stone plates that fit together like a drystone wall. **Shield**, **Shield Wall**. **Weakness:** slow (4").

udesc:giant_breakers.en: Stonemasons armed with steel crowbars and wedges: they split a stone giant along its seam. **Monster-Hunter**; **Armour-Breaker**. **Weakness:** poor shots.

udesc:cable_battery.en: A battery that glides along a cable strung between peaks. **Vehicle**, **Cliff-Climber**, **From the Heights**. **Weakness:** cutting the cable (one critical hit) stops it for one round.

udesc:terrace_fortress.en: A stepped stone fortress that climbs the slope. **Walking Fortress**, **Cliff-Climber**. **Weakness:** slow.

udesc:hero_kusi.en: From a family of bridge-weavers, the only one of her generation who knows every knot of the old weaving. **Rope Bridge**, **Engineer**; **The One-Night Bridge:** once per battle she weaves a bridge over a 12" ravine. **Weakness:** she barely fights.

udesc:hero_wayra.en: Chief of the runners, whose name means "wind": he covers the mountain road in a single day. **Orders**, **Messenger**, **Mountain Folk**; **Relay:** his order reaches every messenger within 18" and spreads 6" from each. **Weakness:** light armour.

udesc:island_nurses.en: Nurses of the coastal villages. **Healer**; they neutralise sea venom within 3". **Weakness:** they barely fight.

udesc:reef_engineers.en: Builders of harbours and lighthouses on the reefs. **Engineer**, **Reef**. **Weakness:** middling fighters.

udesc:conch_signallers.en: Signallers with sea conches: the sound passes from boat to boat. **Messenger**, **Beacon**; allies within 6" get +1 Nerve. **Weakness:** poor fighters.

udesc:harbor_shields.en: Defenders of the jetties, who meet the tentacles with shields. **Shield**, **Shield Wall**. **Weakness:** slow (4").

udesc:bell_divers.en: Fighters from the diving bell, who go down to the edge of the blue hole. **Steam**, **River-Swift**; cover in water. **Weakness:** slow on land (4").

udesc:signal_balloon.en: A balloon of the lighthouse network that spots Lusca's tentacles from above the sea. **Flight**, **Beacon**. **Weakness:** cannot fly in a storm.

udesc:lighthouse_fortress.en: A lighthouse with a fortress wall, moving along the shore. **Walking Fortress**, **Beacon:** no night penalty within 18". **Weakness:** slow.

udesc:hero_marisol.en: A lighthouse keeper's daughter and telegraphist; the only one who can read an alphabet in the lighthouse's flashes. **Messenger**, **Beacon**; **The Lighthouse Alphabet:** once per battle she reveals every ambushing or hidden enemy model within 24". **Weakness:** she barely fights.

udesc:hero_desmond.en: Captain of the Lighthouse-Boat, who has twice survived Lusca's tentacle. **Orders**, **Reef**; **Knowing the Shore:** allies within 6" take no penalty on water terrain. **Weakness:** light armour.

udesc:atoll_riflemen.en: Riflemen of the atolls. **Fires on the Move**, **Reef**. **Weakness:** light armour.

udesc:canoe_healers.en: Healers who travel from island to island by canoe. **Healer**; they neutralise sea venom within 3". **Weakness:** they barely fight.

udesc:outrigger_builders.en: Masters of the outrigger canoe. **Engineer**, **Repair:** a boat or vehicle within 3" regains 1 wound. **Weakness:** middling fighters.

udesc:reef_wall.en: Defenders of the shore with heavy shields, at the mouth of the lagoon. **Shield**, **Shield Wall**, **Reef**. **Weakness:** slow (4").

udesc:deep_divers.en: Divers who meet Hell's submarines on the seabed. **Steam**, **River-Swift**; they strike boats and vehicles with +1 Power. **Weakness:** slow on land (4").

udesc:reef_crawler.en: A steam crawler that walks the reefs and the lagoon. **Vehicle**, **Reef**. **Weakness:** cannot enter deep water.

udesc:floating_island.en: A floating fortress lashed together from many boats — it links island to island. **Walking Fortress**, **Wayfinder**. **Weakness:** cannot go onto land.

udesc:hero_leilani.en: A wayfinder who learned to read the swells from her grandmother. **Wayfinder**, **Orders**; **Knowing the Swell:** once per battle every allied boat and swimming model moves twice. **Weakness:** she barely fights.

udesc:hero_tevita.en: Captain of the twin-hulled war-canoe, who has lived through three clashes with Leviathan's fleet. **Orders**, **Landing**; **Boarding:** Canoe Raiders within 6" get +1 Melee. **Weakness:** light armour.

udesc:forest_path_riflemen.en: Riflemen of the forest paths. **Fires on the Move**. **Weakness:** light armour.

udesc:forest_healers.en: Healers of the forest villages. **Healer**; they neutralise swamp poison within 3". **Weakness:** they barely fight.

udesc:liana_bridge_builders.en: Builders of liana bridges over the rivers. **Engineer**, **Rope Bridge**. **Weakness:** middling fighters.

udesc:scepter_guard.en: Guards of the recovered sceptre. **Shield**, **Shield Wall**; **within 6" of the sceptre:** they do not fall back. **Weakness:** slow (4").

udesc:kirimu_hunters.en: Hunters of the swamp dragons. **Monster-Hunter**, **River-Swift**. **Weakness:** poor shots.

udesc:river_steamer.en: A paddle steamer with armoured sides. **Vehicle**, **River-Swift**. **Weakness:** very slow on land (2").

udesc:canopy_fortress.en: A fortress built in the treetops, crossing from tree to tree by bridges. **Walking Fortress**, **From the Heights**. **Weakness:** Fears Fire.

udesc:hero_maisha.en: A daughter of a family of storytellers and a telegraph engineer. **Messenger**, **Engineer**; **The Returning Tale:** once per battle every ally within 12" recovers its nerve. **Weakness:** she barely fights.

udesc:hero_baraka.en: Captain of Nkuba's Thunder Wagon. **Orders**; **The Call of Thunder:** Nkuba's Thunder Gunners within 6" get +1 to shoot. **Weakness:** light armour.

udesc:ridge_scouts.en: Scouts of the mountain ridges. **Scout**, **Cliff-Climber**. **Weakness:** one Wound.

udesc:peak_healers.en: Healers of the mountain villages. **Healer**, **Mountain Folk**. **Weakness:** they barely fight.

udesc:stone_wall_builders.en: Builders of stone walls. **Engineer**, **Digs Trenches**; quick to build cover on stone. **Weakness:** middling fighters.

udesc:cliff_guard.en: Defenders of the narrow passes of the mountain paths. **Shield**, **Shield Wall**, **Mountain Folk**. **Weakness:** slow (4").

udesc:kammapa_cutters.en: After the epic of Litaolane: they cut open the belly of the swallowing monster and free the swallowed. **Monster-Hunter**; **Release:** an ally caught by a swallowing weapon is freed within 1" of them. **Weakness:** poor shots.

udesc:ridge_battery.en: A steam battery that climbs the ridge. **Vehicle**, **Cliff-Climber**. **Weakness:** slow in the lowlands.

udesc:mountain_fastness.en: A flat-topped mountain fort that has stood up on steam legs. **Walking Fortress**, **From the Heights**. **Weakness:** slow.

udesc:hero_lerato.en: Commander of the Mountain Riflemen. **Orders**, **From the Heights**; **From the Summit:** shooting from the heights reduces Armour by 1. **Weakness:** weak in melee.

udesc:hero_thabo.en: Captain of the Mounted Scouts. **Orders**, **Cavalry**; **The Ridge Road:** allied cavalry within 6" take no penalty on cliffs. **Weakness:** light armour.

udesc:lakeshore_riflemen.en: Riflemen of the lakeshore. **Fires on the Move**. **Weakness:** light armour.

udesc:lake_healers.en: Healers of the lake villages. **Healer**. **Weakness:** they barely fight.

udesc:silence_keepers.en: They remember the lesson of the old tale: when the Digger nears the pit, everyone must fall silent. **Silent**, **Ambush**; **Silence:** allies within 6" get +1 to shoot when they leave an ambush. **Weakness:** light armour.

udesc:pit_guard.en: Heavy infantry standing at the edge of the pits. **Shield**, **Shield Wall**; they strike first at anything climbing out of a pit. **Weakness:** slow (4").

udesc:tunnel_rams.en: Diggers armed with steam drills, who follow the shadows down into the pit. **Steam**, **Tunnel**. **Weakness:** poor shots.

udesc:lake_steamer.en: An armoured steamer guarding the lakeshore. **Vehicle**, **River-Swift**. **Weakness:** very slow on land (2").

udesc:earthwork_fortress.en: An earthwork fortress that pushes forward on steam drills. **Walking Fortress**, **Tunnel**. **Weakness:** slow.

udesc:hero_nakato.en: Commander of the Diggers. **Orders**, **Tunnel**; **Pit Trap:** once per battle a unit emerging from a pit within 12" loses its actions this round. **Weakness:** light armour.

udesc:hero_kato.en: Nakato's twin, the best digger and the quietest man on the lakeshore. **Engineer**, **Silent**, **Tunnel**; **Quick Tunnel:** he can take an allied unit within 12" through a tunnel. **Weakness:** he barely fights.

udesc:dune_scouts.en: Desert scouts who tell a mirage from real water by the colour of the sand. **Scout**, **Trusts No Mirage**. **Weakness:** one Wound.

udesc:oasis_riflemen.en: Riflemen guarding the oases and wells. **Fires on the Move**. **Weakness:** light armour.

udesc:oasis_healers.en: Healers who treat heat and thirst. **Healer**; they lift the heat penalty within 3". **Weakness:** they barely fight.

udesc:mirage_breakers.en: Riflemen who do not shoot at false targets. **Trusts No Mirage**; they pick out ambushers and false targets within 18". **Weakness:** weak in melee.

udesc:caravan_lancers.en: The caravans' heavy guards on horseback. **Cavalry**, **Trench-Breaker**, charge. **Weakness:** poor shots.

udesc:sand_crawler.en: A broad-wheeled steam crawler that does not sink in the dunes. **Vehicle**; no penalty on sand. **Weakness:** −1 to shoot in a sandstorm.

udesc:granary_fortress.en: A fortress like an agadir — a fortified granary — on steam legs. **Walking Fortress**, **Supply**. **Weakness:** slow.

udesc:hero_tileli.en: Daughter of a khettara digger; her name means "freedom" in Amazigh. **Engineer**, **Trusts No Mirage**; **Real Water:** once per battle she dispels every false target and mirage within 12". **Weakness:** she barely fights.

udesc:hero_idir.en: Captain of the Caravan Guards; his name means "alive". **Orders**; **The Caravan Circle:** allies within 6" gain cover in the open desert. **Weakness:** light armour.

udesc:dust_scouts.en: Goggled scouts who do not lose their way in a dust storm. **Scout**; no penalty in a storm. **Weakness:** one Wound.

udesc:caravanserai_healers.en: Healers of the caravanserais. **Healer**; they treat those blinded by dust within 3". **Weakness:** they barely fight.

udesc:white_div_hunters.en: Riflemen who hunt divs. **Giant-Hunter**, **Mountain Folk**. **Weakness:** middling armour.

udesc:pass_gunners.en: Machine-guns guarding the mountain passes. Their fire **pins**; **Mountain Folk**. **Weakness:** slow.

udesc:rakhsh_guard.en: A heavy cavalry guard named after Rostam's horse. **Cavalry**, **Trench-Breaker**, charge. **Weakness:** poor shots.

udesc:tulpar_balloon.en: A balloon in the shape of the winged horse — the tulpar. **Flight**; scouting over the mountains. **Weakness:** cannot fly in a dust storm.

udesc:caravanserai_fortress.en: A high-walled caravanserai on steam wheels. **Walking Fortress**, **Supply**. **Weakness:** slow.

udesc:hero_aigerim.en: A steppe scout who walks through a dust storm without goggles. **Scout**, **Ambush**, **Orders**; **The Storm Road:** allies within 6" take no penalty in a storm. **Weakness:** light armour.

udesc:hero_bakhyt.en: Captain of the Heirs of Rostam; his name means "happiness". **Orders**; **Rostam's Example:** allies within 6" automatically pass div Fear tests. **Weakness:** slow (5").

udesc:harbor_riflemen.en: Harbour riflemen. **Fires on the Move**. **Weakness:** light armour.

udesc:ship_healers.en: Healers of the dhows. **Healer**; they neutralise sea venom within 3". **Weakness:** they barely fight.

udesc:current_readers.en: Sailors who can tell from current and wind where the "island" sleeps. **Wayfinder**, **Scout**. **Weakness:** light armour.

udesc:deck_shields.en: Defenders of the deck with heavy shields. **Shield**, **Shield Wall**, **Landing**. **Weakness:** slow (4").

udesc:anchor_bearers.en: Heavy sailors with steam anchors: they hurl the anchor at a monster and tie it to the shore. **Steam**; the anchor is a **Grab**. **Weakness:** poor shots.

udesc:harbor_crawler.en: An armour-crawler of the jetties. **Vehicle**, **Landing**. **Weakness:** slow in sand.

udesc:harbor_tower.en: A harbour fortress with a wind-tower, which follows the shore. **Walking Fortress**, **Beacon**. **Weakness:** slow.

udesc:hero_laila.en: A dhow helmswoman and a pearl diver's daughter; she knows every current of the Gulf by heart. **Orders**, **Wayfinder**; **The Current:** allied boats within 6" get +2" Move. **Weakness:** light armour.

udesc:hero_saeed.en: A pearl diver who went down beneath the "sleeping island" on a single breath. **Fearless**, **River-Swift**; **From Below:** he attacks from water terrain and reduces a Size 3–4 target's Armour by 1. **Weakness:** a poor shot.

udesc:sea_islands_regulars.en: Southeast Asian Isles and Shores: rank-and-file. Trench infantry in gas masks: rifle and bayonet, **Line**, **Gas Mask**. The backbone of the warband and its cheapest troops.

udesc:sea_islands_thugs.en: Southeast Asian Isles and Shores: clubmen. Trench raiders: revolver, club and a sharpened trench spade, **Frenzy**, **Gas Mask**, **Trench Brawler** (+1 Melee in a trench). Made for night raids. **Weakness:** poor shots.

udesc:gong_warriors.en: **Gong:** with one action, enemies within 6" take Nerve tests at −1 and allies at +1; sea monsters and winged creatures cannot come within 6" while the gong rings. **Weakness:** they cannot shoot.

udesc:bangka_raiders.en: 8" Move, **Landing** from a water or shore edge. **Weakness:** light armour.

udesc:moon_watchers.en: Night watchmen who can tell from the colour of the moon that the Bakunawa is rising. **Scout**, **Night-Eye**. **Weakness:** one Wound.

udesc:coast_riflemen.en: Riflemen of the coastal villages. **Fires on the Move**. **Weakness:** light armour.

udesc:island_herbalists.en: Herbalists of the islands. **Healer**. **Weakness:** they barely fight.

udesc:gong_wall.en: Heavy infantry with brass gong-shields: the shield rings when struck. **Shield**, **Shield Wall**, **Gong**. **Weakness:** slow (4").

udesc:rattan_guard.en: Heavy infantry in armour of woven rattan and brass. **Shield**, **Fearless**. **Weakness:** Fears Fire.

udesc:gong_balloon.en: A balloon hung with hundreds of gongs: the din drives the Bakunawa away from the moon. **Flight**, **Gong**. **Weakness:** cannot fly in a storm.

udesc:stilt_village.en: A village-fortress built on stilts, which moves along the seashore. **Walking Fortress**, **Reef**. **Weakness:** slow.

udesc:hero_ligaya.en: A gong-player and electrician; her name means "joy". **Gong**, **Song**; **Electric Gong:** once per battle every enemy within 12" takes a Nerve test — those who fail cannot attack this round. **Weakness:** she barely fights.

udesc:hero_bayani.en: Captain of the Bangka Raiders; his name means "hero". **Orders**, **Landing**; **The Shout Together:** allies within 6" get +1 Nerve when they charge. **Weakness:** light armour.

udesc:korea_regulars.en: Korean Peninsula: rank-and-file. Trench infantry in gas masks: rifle and bayonet, **Line**, **Gas Mask**. The backbone of the warband and its cheapest troops.

udesc:korea_thugs.en: Korean Peninsula: clubmen. Trench raiders: revolver, club and a sharpened trench spade, **Frenzy**, **Gas Mask**, **Trench Brawler** (+1 Melee in a trench). Made for night raids. **Weakness:** poor shots.

udesc:haetae_firewardens.en: **Fireproof:** fire cannot set them alight; with one action they put out a burning ally within 3". **Weakness:** weak shooting.

udesc:tiger_hunters.en: **Mountain rifle** (30", Power 3, Damage 2, Giant-Hunter); they climb cliffs. **Weakness:** middling in melee.

udesc:dokkaebi_bargainers.en: **Cunning (Discord):** once per round one enemy model within 12" takes only 1 action on its next activation. **Weakness:** they do not fight.

udesc:mountain_trackers.en: Trackers of the mountain villages. **Scout**, **Ambush**, **Mountain Folk**. **Weakness:** one Wound.

udesc:village_riflemen.en: Riflemen of the mountain villages. **Fires on the Move**, **Mountain Folk**. **Weakness:** light armour.

udesc:fortress_wall_guard.en: Heavy defenders of the mountain fortress-walls. **Shield**, **Shield Wall**. **Weakness:** slow (4").

udesc:imugi_hunters.en: Serpent hunters who catch the imugi before it becomes a dragon. **Monster-Hunter**, **River-Swift**. **Weakness:** poor shots.

udesc:haetae_engine.en: A steam walker in the shape of the fire-eating guardian beast — the haetae. **Forged**, **Fireproof**, **Burns Gas**; **Swallowing Fire:** it puts out fire markers within 6". **Weakness:** slow in water.

udesc:village_fortress.en: A mountain village with a stone wall, on steam legs. **Walking Fortress**, **Cliff-Climber**. **Weakness:** slow.

udesc:hero_mire.en: A mountain village storyteller's granddaughter and a geologist; her name means "the future". **Engineer**, **Finds the Weak Spot**; **Layers of the Mountain:** once per battle she brings down a cliff within 12", opening or closing a pass. **Weakness:** she barely fights.

udesc:hero_jiho.en: Captain of the Haetae Fire-Wardens. **Orders**, **Fireproof**; **Bucket Chain:** allies within 6" put out a fire marker in half a round. **Weakness:** light armour.

udesc:mongolia_regulars.en: Mongolian Steppe and Gobi: rank-and-file. Trench infantry in gas masks: rifle and bayonet, **Line**, **Gas Mask**. The backbone of the warband and its cheapest troops.

udesc:mongolia_thugs.en: Mongolian Steppe and Gobi: clubmen. Trench raiders: revolver, club and a sharpened trench spade, **Frenzy**, **Gas Mask**, **Trench Brawler** (+1 Melee in a trench). Made for night raids. **Weakness:** poor shots.

udesc:urtuu_riders.en: 12" Move, cavalry. **Messenger:** once per round they pass the leader's order to an ally within 18". **Weakness:** light armour.

udesc:eagle_hunters.en: **Eagle** (18", indirect — ignores cover); scouts. **Weakness:** one Wound.

udesc:steppe_riflemen.en: Scouts, cheap and numerous. **Weakness:** one Wound.

udesc:keshig.en: Cavalry (12"), **Fires on the Move**, horse bow (2 Attacks). **Weakness:** middling in melee.

udesc:gobi_healers.en: Healers of the steppe and the Gobi. **Healer**. **Weakness:** they barely fight.

udesc:mangus_hunters.en: Hunters of the many-headed giants. **Monster-Hunter**; +1 Attack against a many-headed monster. **Weakness:** slow.

udesc:woodwrights.en: Masters who build without iron — the sand worms are drawn to iron. **Engineer**; **Without Iron:** what they build does not attract the sand worm. **Weakness:** middling fighters.

udesc:felt_shields.en: Heavy infantry in thick felt and bone armour — without iron. **Shield**, **Shield Wall**; they withstand lightning as normal. **Weakness:** slow (4").

udesc:camel_walker.en: A steam walker in the shape of a two-humped camel, with cargo and riflemen. **Forged**, **Supply**; no penalty on sand. **Weakness:** turns slowly.

udesc:felt_citadel.en: A great felt-walled fortress on wheels, built without iron. **Walking Fortress**; the sand worm leaves it alone. **Weakness:** Fears Fire.

udesc:hero_saran.en: An örtöö rider; her name means "moon". **Orders**, **Cavalry**, **Messenger**; **The Örtöö Road:** her order reaches every messenger within 18". **Weakness:** light armour.

udesc:hero_batbayar.en: An eagle hunter whose eagle sees the sand worm even beneath the sand. **Scout**; the eagle attacks **from above**; **Eagle-Eye:** he sees anything hidden in a tunnel or under the sand within 18". **Weakness:** weak in melee.

udesc:arctic_regulars.en: Arctic Ice and Tundra: rank-and-file. Trench infantry in gas masks: rifle and bayonet, **Line**, **Gas Mask**. The backbone of the warband and its cheapest troops.

udesc:arctic_thugs.en: Arctic Ice and Tundra: clubmen. Trench raiders: revolver, club and a sharpened trench spade, **Frenzy**, **Gas Mask**, **Trench Brawler** (+1 Melee in a trench). Made for night raids. **Weakness:** poor shots.

udesc:sled_riders.en: 11" Move; **Ice-Swift:** no penalty on ice and snow. **Weakness:** they slow down in trenches and on cliffs.

udesc:ice_readers.en: **Reads the Ice:** they spot thin ice, open water and enemies hidden under the ice within 12"; they show allies the safe way across the ice. **Weakness:** one Wound.

udesc:kayak_hunters.en: **Harpoon** (12", Power 3, Damage 2, Giant-Hunter, net); no penalty on water. **Weakness:** short range.

udesc:ice_riflemen.en: Riflemen on the ice. **Fires on the Move**, **Winter-Born**, **Ice-Swift**. **Weakness:** light armour.

udesc:ice_camp_healers.en: Camp healers who treat frostbite and the cold of the water under the ice. **Healer**, **Winter-Born**. **Weakness:** they barely fight.

udesc:snowblock_builders.en: Builders of walls and shelters from snow blocks. **Engineer**, **Digs Trenches**; twice as fast at building cover on snow. **Weakness:** middling fighters.

udesc:ice_wall_guard.en: Guards of the edge of the open water, with ice shields. **Shield**, **Shield Wall**, **Winter-Born**. **Weakness:** slow (4").

udesc:ice_cutters.en: Ice-cutters with steam saws: they open the ice beneath whatever climbs out of the open water. **Steam**, **Reads the Ice**; **Cutting the Ice:** once per battle they turn 3" of ice into water. **Weakness:** poor shots.

udesc:icebreaker_sled.en: A steam sledge with an icebreaker prow. **Vehicle**, **Ice-Swift**. **Weakness:** slow in mud and on stone.

udesc:ice_floe_fortress.en: A fortress built on a huge block of ice, driven by steam screws. **Walking Fortress**, **Reads the Ice**. **Weakness:** −2 Armour in a warm scenario.

udesc:hero_anuka.en: An ice-reader and dog-driver. **Reads the Ice**, **Ice-Swift**, **Orders**; **The Dog Team:** once per battle she moves 18" by sledge. **Weakness:** light armour.

udesc:hero_aput.en: Captain of the Kayak Hunters, who winters at the edge of the open water. **Orders**, **Winter-Born**; **The Floe Edge:** allies within 6" strike first at anything coming out of the water. **Weakness:** light armour.

udesc:siberia_regulars.en: Siberian Taiga: rank-and-file. Trench infantry in gas masks: rifle and bayonet, **Line**, **Gas Mask**. The backbone of the warband and its cheapest troops.

udesc:siberia_thugs.en: Siberian Taiga: clubmen. Trench raiders: revolver, club and a sharpened trench spade, **Frenzy**, **Gas Mask**, **Trench Brawler** (+1 Melee in a trench). Made for night raids. **Weakness:** poor shots.

udesc:olonkho_singers.en: **Song:** allies within 6" take Nerve tests at +1; creatures of the lower world and demons within 6" get −1 Melee while the song lasts (the singer cannot move). **Weakness:** they do not fight.

udesc:reindeer_riders.en: 9" Move, no penalty in forest and snow; scouts. **Weakness:** light armour.

udesc:taiga_trackers.en: Trackers of the taiga. **Scout**, **Ambush**, **Winter-Born**. **Weakness:** one Wound.

udesc:taiga_healers.en: Healers of the taiga villages. **Healer**, **Winter-Born**. **Weakness:** they barely fight.

udesc:permafrost_diggers.en: Diggers who meet the tunnels of the underground beasts. **Engineer**, **Digs Trenches**, **Tunnel**. **Weakness:** middling fighters.

udesc:larch_shields.en: Heavy infantry with shields of hard larch wood. **Shield**, **Shield Wall**, **Winter-Born**. **Weakness:** slow (4").

udesc:abaasy_hunters.en: Hunters of the one-eyed, iron-coloured beings. **Monster-Hunter**; **The Eye:** +1 Power against a one-eyed target. **Weakness:** poor shots.

udesc:reindeer_sled_battery.en: A battery mounted on a steam sledge. **Vehicle**, **Ice-Swift**. **Weakness:** slow in forest.

udesc:log_fortress.en: A fortress built of larch logs, on runners. **Walking Fortress**, **Winter-Born**. **Weakness:** Fears Fire.

udesc:hero_sardaana.en: Granddaughter of an olonkho singer, and a telegraphist. **Song**, **Messenger**; **Night of the Epic:** once per battle allies within 12" automatically pass Fear and Nerve tests this round. **Weakness:** she barely fights.

udesc:hero_nyurgun.en: A taiga commander who bears the name of the hero of the epic. **Orders**, **Winter-Born**; **Call of the Epic:** allies within 6" get +1 in melee against a Tier IV–V model. **Weakness:** slow (5").

udesc:balkans_regulars.en: Balkan Mountains: rank-and-file. Trench infantry in gas masks: rifle and bayonet, **Line**, **Gas Mask**. The backbone of the warband and its cheapest troops.

udesc:balkans_thugs.en: Balkan Mountains: clubmen. Trench raiders: revolver, club and a sharpened trench spade, **Frenzy**, **Gas Mask**, **Trench Brawler** (+1 Melee in a trench). Made for night raids. **Weakness:** poor shots.

udesc:dragon_born.en: **Flight** (steam wings, 8"), **Fearless**; +1 in melee against winged enemies and cloud/weather creatures. **Weakness:** fire and lightning damage the wings — after being wounded they cannot fly for one round.

udesc:wind_readers.en: **Trusts No Mirage:** they see through ambushes and illusions; at the start of the battle they foresee weather events (wind, fog) — their side may choose the round of one such event. **Weakness:** one Wound.

udesc:mountain_wardens.en: They climb cliffs; cheap riflemen. **Weakness:** one Wound.

udesc:valley_herbalists.en: Herbalists of the mountain valleys, who treat drought fever and hail wounds. **Healer**, **Mountain Folk**. **Weakness:** they barely fight.

udesc:hail_cannons.en: Funnel-mouthed cannons that fire into the clouds and break up the kulshedra's hail. **Artillery**, **Sky-Breaker**. **Weakness:** reload.

udesc:cistern_builders.en: Builders of cisterns and channels against drought. **Engineer**, **Digs Trenches**; **Supply:** allies within 6" take no drought penalty. **Weakness:** middling fighters.

udesc:gorge_shields.en: Heavy infantry guarding the narrow gorges. **Shield**, **Shield Wall**, **Mountain Folk**. **Weakness:** slow (4").

udesc:dragon_guard.en: Warriors born with marks on their shoulders, who have not yet learned to fly. **Marked**, **Shield**, **Fearless**. **Weakness:** expensive.

udesc:cloud_cutter.en: A balloon that flies into a hailcloud and breaks it up from inside. **Flight**, **Sky-Breaker**. **Weakness:** −2" Move in a storm.

udesc:gorge_fortress.en: A stone fortress that bars the gorge and moves on steam legs. **Walking Fortress**, **Cliff-Climber**. **Weakness:** slow.

udesc:hero_elena.en: A dragon-woman, marked on the shoulders from birth, and keeper of a weather station. **Orders**, **Flight**, **Marked**; **Battle in the Clouds:** while flying, +1 Melee against winged and cloud monsters. **Weakness:** light armour on the ground.

udesc:hero_stojan.en: Chief of the Wind-Readers, who sees hail a day ahead. **Scout**, **Orders**; **Foretelling the Weather:** you choose the scenario's weather at the start of the battle. **Weakness:** he barely fights.

udesc:pyrenean_regulars.en: Pyrenean Mountains: rank-and-file. Trench infantry in gas masks: rifle and bayonet, **Line**, **Gas Mask**. The backbone of the warband and its cheapest troops.

udesc:pyrenean_thugs.en: Pyrenean Mountains: clubmen. Trench raiders: revolver, club and a sharpened trench spade, **Frenzy**, **Gas Mask**, **Trench Brawler** (+1 Melee in a trench). Made for night raids. **Weakness:** poor shots.

udesc:basajaun_shepherds.en: Scouts, **Night-Eye**; at the start of the battle they reveal one ambushing enemy unit. **Weakness:** one Wound.

udesc:miner_sappers.en: Digging trenches; **explosive charge** (6", Power 4, Damage 2, blast, one-shot) — it wrecks fortifications and barbed wire. **Weakness:** weak shooting.

udesc:cyclops_hunters.en: **Mountain rifle** (30", Power 3, Damage 2, Giant-Hunter); a critical hit on a Size 3–4 target gives it −2 Shoot until the end of the battle (the eye). **Weakness:** weak in melee.

udesc:almogavars.en: **Mountain Folk**, **Fires on the Move**; javelins (10", 2 Attacks). **Weakness:** light armour.

udesc:pass_riflemen.en: Riflemen of the mountain passes. **Fires on the Move**, **Mountain Folk**. **Weakness:** light armour.

udesc:mine_doctors.en: Mine doctors, who treat those dug out of collapsed shafts. **Healer**; no penalty in tunnels. **Weakness:** they barely fight.

udesc:cave_shields.en: Defenders of the cave mouths. **Shield**, **Shield Wall**; they do not fall back in a narrow passage. **Weakness:** slow (4").

udesc:cuelebre_slayers.en: Hunters of winged serpents. **Monster-Hunter**, **Sky-Breaker**. **Weakness:** poor shots.

udesc:ore_cart_battery.en: An armoured battery mounted on mine carts. **Vehicle**, **On Rails**, **Tunnel**. **Weakness:** slow off the rails.

udesc:pass_fortress.en: A fortress of the mountain pass, which bars the way to the one-eyed giants. **Walking Fortress**, **Cliff-Climber**. **Weakness:** slow.

udesc:hero_amaia.en: A miner's daughter and cave explorer. **Engineer**, **Tunnel**, **Night-Eye**; **Map of the Underworld:** once per battle she brings an allied unit out of a cave within 18". **Weakness:** she barely fights.

udesc:hero_inaki.en: A veteran captain of the Mountain Shields, who has met the one-eyed giant twice. **Orders**, **Mountain Folk**; **The One-Eye Trap:** allies within 6" get +1 to shoot at Size 3–4 targets. **Weakness:** slow (5").

udesc:alps_regulars.en: The Alps: rank-and-file. Trench infantry in gas masks: rifle and bayonet, **Line**, **Gas Mask**. The backbone of the warband and its cheapest troops.

udesc:alps_thugs.en: The Alps: clubmen. Trench raiders: revolver, club and a sharpened trench spade, **Frenzy**, **Gas Mask**, **Trench Brawler** (+1 Melee in a trench). Made for night raids. **Weakness:** poor shots.

udesc:ice_climbers.en: They climb cliffs and ice; ice axe (2 Attacks). +1 Melee when charging from a cliff. **Weakness:** weak shooting.

udesc:avalanche_sappers.en: **Avalanche charge** (12", Power 4, Damage 2, blast, indirect, one-shot); on a mountain map the charge creates a 3" avalanche strip (crossing it eats the whole move). **Weakness:** a single shot.

udesc:alpine_riflemen.en: 36" rifle; they climb cliffs. **Weakness:** one Wound.

udesc:reislaufer.en: Long pike (2", **Pins** — cavalry loses its charge bonus); **Fearless**. **Weakness:** slow.

udesc:chamois_trackers.en: Alpine trackers who walk the cliffs like chamois. **Scout**, **Cliff-Climber**. **Weakness:** one Wound.

udesc:mountain_rescue.en: Rescuers who bring people out of avalanches and crevasses. **Healer**, **Cliff-Climber**; they dig out an ally caught in an avalanche within 3". **Weakness:** they barely fight.

udesc:tatzelwurm_hunters.en: Hunters of the lizard-dragons in the ice caves. **Monster-Hunter**, **Winter-Born**. **Weakness:** slow.

udesc:glacier_guard.en: Heavy defenders of the glacier passes. **Shield**, **Shield Wall**, **Winter-Born**. **Weakness:** slow (4").

udesc:avalanche_mortar.en: A mortar that brings an avalanche down on the enemy. **Vehicle**; its fire is **Indirect**; **Avalanche:** once per battle it makes a 6" strip below a slope hard going. **Weakness:** the avalanche does not work in the lowlands.

udesc:alpine_fortress.en: A stone fortress on cog-wheeled legs, which climbs the slope. **Walking Fortress**, **Cliff-Climber**. **Weakness:** slow.

udesc:hero_anna.en: A guide's daughter and a huntress. **Giant-Hunter**, **Cliff-Climber**; **A Price on Its Head:** once per battle her damage against a monster or a Tier IV–V model is doubled. **Weakness:** weak in melee.

udesc:hero_reto.en: A veteran of the valley guides, who knows every path and every avalanche line. **Orders**, **Cliff-Climber**; **The Guide:** allies within 6" take no penalty on cliffs and snow. **Weakness:** light armour.

udesc:baltic_regulars.en: Baltic Forests and Shore: rank-and-file. Trench infantry in gas masks: rifle and bayonet, **Line**, **Gas Mask**. The backbone of the warband and its cheapest troops.

udesc:baltic_thugs.en: Baltic Forests and Shore: clubmen. Trench raiders: revolver, club and a sharpened trench spade, **Frenzy**, **Gas Mask**, **Trench Brawler** (+1 Melee in a trench). Made for night raids. **Weakness:** poor shots.

udesc:gate_wardens.en: **Shield Wall**; while guarding an objective (a gate, a seal) they take no Fear tests. **Weakness:** slow.

udesc:amber_alchemists.en: **Resin:** they close 1 wound on an ally within 3"; once per battle they make an objective (a seal, a gate) undamageable for one round. **Weakness:** they barely fight.

udesc:marsh_riflemen.en: **Ambush**; they move through marsh with no penalty. **Weakness:** one Wound.

udesc:dune_riflemen.en: Riflemen of the coastal dunes. **Fires on the Move**. **Weakness:** light armour.

udesc:linden_healers.en: Village healers skilled with linden, nettle and amber powder. **Healer**. **Weakness:** they barely fight.

udesc:bog_wardens.en: Watchmen who meet the servants of the underworld as they rise from the bog. **Monster-Hunter**; no penalty in marsh. **Weakness:** slow.

udesc:daina_singers.en: Singers of the folk songs — the dainas. **Song:** allies within 6" get +1 Nerve. **Weakness:** poor fighters.

udesc:amber_lancers.en: Heavy cavalry in amber-studded armour. **Cavalry**, **Trench-Breaker**, charge. **Weakness:** poor shots.

udesc:coastal_battery.en: A coastal gun on a steam carriage, to meet whatever rises from the seabed. **Vehicle**, **Landing**. **Weakness:** slow in marsh.

udesc:hillfort_walker.en: A wooden hillfort on steam legs. **Walking Fortress**; **The Hill:** those inside shoot as if from the heights. **Weakness:** Fears Fire.

udesc:hero_kaia.en: An amber-smith's daughter. **Alchemy**, **Repair**; **Amber Shield:** once per battle allies within 6" get +1 Armour for one round. **Weakness:** she barely fights.

udesc:hero_lauris.en: Captain of the Gate Wardens. **Orders**; **The Gate Is Shut:** allies within 6" do not fall back on a bridge, at a gate or in a pass. **Weakness:** slow (5").

udesc:australia_regulars.en: Australian Interior: rank-and-file. Trench infantry in gas masks: rifle and bayonet, **Line**, **Gas Mask**. The backbone of the warband and its cheapest troops.

udesc:australia_thugs.en: Australian Interior: clubmen. Trench raiders: revolver, club and a sharpened trench spade, **Frenzy**, **Gas Mask**, **Trench Brawler** (+1 Melee in a trench). Made for night raids. **Weakness:** poor shots.

udesc:drovers.en: Cavalry (12"); **The Herd's Trail:** once per battle, while moving, they make the strip they cross (2" wide) impassable to fire. **Weakness:** light armour.

udesc:firebreak_crews.en: **Digs Trenches**; **Fireproof:** −1 fire damage (min. 0), they pass through a line of fire with no penalty. **Weakness:** poor fighters.

udesc:bush_nurses.en: Nurses of the interior who ride from station to station. **Healer**; they treat burns within 3". **Weakness:** they barely fight.

udesc:well_borers.en: Borers of deep wells: they meet the dry storm with water. **Engineer**, **Digs Trenches**; **Water:** once per battle they put out fire markers within 6". **Weakness:** middling fighters.

udesc:rod_gunners.en: Riflemen who catch the dry lightning with lightning rods and fire it back. **Burns Gas**; the rifle is **Lightning**. **Weakness:** −1 to shoot in rain.

udesc:stockade_guard.en: Heavy defenders of the station stockades. **Shield**, **Shield Wall**, **Fireproof**. **Weakness:** slow (4").

udesc:steam_firefighters.en: Firefighters with steam pumps: they put out the trail of the fire-tailed deer. **Steam**, **Fireproof**; the jet **pins**. **Weakness:** short range.

udesc:road_train.en: A steam tractor hauling a chain of wagons, without rails. **Vehicle**, **Supply**. **Weakness:** turns badly.

udesc:homestead_fortress.en: A homestead with a water tank and a stockade, on steam wheels. **Walking Fortress**, **Fireproof**. **Weakness:** slow.

udesc:hero_elsie.en: A telegraphist's daughter and a map-maker. **Messenger**, **Orders**; **The Fire Map:** once per battle she sees the fire line 12" ahead — allies avoid fire markers this round. **Weakness:** she barely fights.

udesc:hero_jack.en: A veteran drover who follows the trail of the fire-tailed deer on horseback. **Orders**, **Cavalry**; **The Stock Route:** allied cavalry within 6" get +2" Move. **Weakness:** light armour.

udesc:prussia_regulars.en: Prussia: rank-and-file. Trench infantry in gas masks: rifle and bayonet, **Line**, **Gas Mask**. The backbone of the warband and its cheapest troops.

udesc:prussia_thugs.en: Prussia: clubmen. Trench raiders: revolver, club and a sharpened trench spade, **Frenzy**, **Gas Mask**, **Trench Brawler** (+1 Melee in a trench). Made for night raids. **Weakness:** poor shots.

udesc:harz_miners.en: **Digs Trenches**, **Tunnel**; **The Kobold's Knock:** they spot an enemy hiding in a tunnel within 6". **Weakness:** poor shots.

udesc:wieland_smiths.en: **Repair** (a vehicle or Forged model regains 1 wound in battle); the smith's sledge is an **Armour-Breaker**. **Weakness:** slow.

udesc:grenadiers.en: Hand grenades (8", **Blast**) — for clearing trenches; **Gas Mask**. **Weakness:** the grenades are short-ranged.

udesc:jaegers.en: Light infantry drawn from forest huntsmen. **Fires on the Move**, **Ambush**. **Weakness:** light armour.

udesc:field_surgeons.en: Surgeons of the field hospital. **Healer**. **Weakness:** they barely fight.

udesc:shaft_guard.en: Heavy defenders of the mouths of the old shafts. **Shield**, **Shield Wall**, **Tunnel**. **Weakness:** slow (4").

udesc:lindwurm_hunters.en: Hunters of the wingless dragon-serpents. **Monster-Hunter**, **Tunnel**. **Weakness:** poor shots.

udesc:observation_airship.en: An observation zeppelin that watches the shafts from above for anything coming up. **Flight**; sees ambushers within 24". **Weakness:** cannot fly in a storm.

udesc:shaft_tower_fortress.en: A pithead winding tower turned into a steel fortress. **Walking Fortress**, **Tunnel**. **Weakness:** slow.

udesc:hero_grete.en: Daughter of a mine surveyor — a maker of underground maps. **Engineer**, **Finds the Weak Spot**, **Tunnel**; **The Old Map:** once per battle she foresees where something will come out of a tunnel — allies strike first there. **Weakness:** she barely fights.

udesc:hero_konrad.en: A Landwehr captain, formerly chief of the Harz miners. **Orders**, **Tunnel**; **The Miner's Voice:** allies within 6" take no penalty in tunnels. **Weakness:** slow (5").

udesc:batavi_regulars.en: The Batavi: rank-and-file. Trench infantry in gas masks: rifle and bayonet, **Line**, **Gas Mask**. The backbone of the warband and its cheapest troops.

udesc:batavi_thugs.en: The Batavi: clubmen. Trench raiders: revolver, club and a sharpened trench spade, **Frenzy**, **Gas Mask**, **Trench Brawler** (+1 Melee in a trench). Made for night raids. **Weakness:** poor shots.

udesc:dike_wardens.en: **Digs Trenches**; **The Sluice:** once per battle, in low ground, a **Flood** (3" radius, half Move). **Weakness:** poor fighters.

udesc:skate_riflemen.en: Scouts; +3" Move on ice and frozen canals. **Weakness:** one Wound, no armour.

udesc:klabauter_crews.en: **Supply** (an adjacent unit reloads at once), **Repair**; they say the Klabautermann shows them the cracks. **Weakness:** light armour.

udesc:batavian_riders.en: Cavalry; **River-Swift** — they cross rivers and canals on horseback with no penalty (a famous skill of the old Batavi). **Weakness:** light armour.

udesc:polder_nurses.en: Nurses of the lowland villages. **Healer**; they pull anyone who falls into the water within 3" back out. **Weakness:** they barely fight.

udesc:pump_engineers.en: Engineers of the steam pumps. **Engineer**, **Flood:** once per battle they flood or drain a 6" strip. **Weakness:** middling fighters.

udesc:sluice_guard.en: Heavy defenders of the sluices and dikes. **Shield**, **Shield Wall**. **Weakness:** slow (4").

udesc:fog_cutters.en: Heavy sailors who meet the ghost-ships of the fog by boarding them. **Steam**, **Trusts No Mirage**; the hook is a **Grab**. **Weakness:** poor shots.

udesc:canal_monitor.en: A low armoured boat for the canals. **Vehicle**, **River-Swift**. **Weakness:** very slow on land (2").

udesc:polder_fortress.en: A dike fortress that holds back the water and the enemy together. **Walking Fortress**, **Flood**. **Weakness:** slow.

udesc:hero_anneke.en: A dike warden's daughter. **Engineer**, **Flood**; **Voice of the Dike:** once per battle she stops the spawn of the water-wolf within 12" for one round. **Weakness:** she barely fights.

udesc:hero_pieter.en: Captain of the Canal Monitor, who has fought the ghost-ships in the fog twice. **Orders**, **River-Swift**; **The Fog Bell:** allies within 6" take no penalty in murk. **Weakness:** light armour.

udesc:lechia_regulars.en: Lechia: rank-and-file. Trench infantry in gas masks: rifle and bayonet, **Line**, **Gas Mask**. The backbone of the warband and its cheapest troops.

udesc:lechia_thugs.en: Lechia: clubmen. Trench raiders: revolver, club and a sharpened trench spade, **Frenzy**, **Gas Mask**, **Trench Brawler** (+1 Melee in a trench). Made for night raids. **Weakness:** poor shots.

udesc:winged_hussars.en: Heavy cavalry (10"), long lance (2", **Charge**, Damage 2), **Trench-Breaker**. **Weakness:** poor shots, expensive.

udesc:salt_miners.en: **Digs Trenches**, **Tunnel**; **The Skarbnik's Knock:** once per battle they automatically pass a collapse or trap test. **Weakness:** poor shots.

udesc:skuba_trappers.en: **Giant-** and **Monster-Hunters**; salt grenade (8", blast, Damage 2, Anti-Giant). **Weakness:** short range; weak in melee.

udesc:shore_scouts.en: Riverbank scouts who can tell from the colour of the water that a utopiec is rising. **Scout**, **River-Swift**. **Weakness:** one Wound.

udesc:salt_healers.en: Healers of the healing caves of the salt mines. **Healer**; they neutralise poison within 3". **Weakness:** they barely fight.

udesc:utopiec_hunters.en: Hunters of the river creatures. **Monster-Hunter**, **River-Swift**. **Weakness:** slow.

udesc:salt_mine_shields.en: Heavy defenders of the salt shafts. **Shield**, **Shield Wall**, **Tunnel**. **Weakness:** slow (4").

udesc:sulfur_ram.en: After Skuba's trick: a ram-shaped walker stuffed with sulphur charges — if the dragon swallows it, it explodes from inside. **Forged**; **The Last Trick:** when destroyed, everything within 3" takes 1 hit, Power 5. **Weakness:** Fears Fire.

udesc:krak_hill_fortress.en: A fortress-hall built on a mound, on steam legs. **Walking Fortress**, **From the Heights**. **Weakness:** slow.

udesc:hero_zosia.en: A salt miner's daughter. **Engineer**, **Tunnel**; **Salt Wall:** once per battle allies within 6" take no fire damage for one round. **Weakness:** she barely fights.

udesc:hero_jan.en: A young chorąży of the Winged Hussars. **Orders**, **Cavalry**; **The Sound of Wings:** when he charges, enemies within 6" take Nerve tests at −1. **Weakness:** thrown from the saddle, he moves 6".

udesc:byzantium_regulars.en: Byzantium: rank-and-file. Trench infantry in gas masks: rifle and bayonet, **Line**, **Gas Mask**. The backbone of the warband and its cheapest troops.

udesc:byzantium_thugs.en: Byzantium: clubmen. Trench raiders: revolver, club and a sharpened trench spade, **Frenzy**, **Gas Mask**, **Trench Brawler** (+1 Melee in a trench). Made for night raids. **Weakness:** poor shots.

udesc:fire_siphoneers.en: Fire siphon (8", 2 Attacks, **Fire**); sea fire burns even on water. **Weakness:** short range.

udesc:harbor_lookouts.en: Watchers in the towers of the strait, who see a storm coming in a clear sky. **Scout**, **Beacon**. **Weakness:** one Wound.

udesc:akritai.en: Border guards bearing the name of the old frontier troops. **Fires on the Move**. **Weakness:** light armour.

udesc:harbor_physicians.en: Physicians of the city hospital. **Healer**. **Weakness:** they barely fight.

udesc:chain_engineers.en: Engineers who tend the great chain of the strait. **Engineer**; the thrower **Entangles**. **Weakness:** short range.

udesc:chain_tower_guard.en: The elite guard of the Chain Tower. **Shield**, **Fearless**. **Weakness:** expensive.

udesc:siphon_boat.en: A paddle boat with a great siphon. **Vehicle**, **River-Swift**; sea fire burns even on water. **Weakness:** short range.

udesc:chain_tower.en: The chain tower of the strait, on steam legs. **Walking Fortress**; **Drawing the Chain:** once per battle it stops models moving on water within 12" for one round. **Weakness:** slow.

udesc:hero_marina.en: A ferryman's daughter who knows every current of the strait. **Wayfinder**, **Messenger**; **The Ferry:** once per battle she carries an allied unit 12" across water. **Weakness:** she barely fights.

udesc:hero_leon.en: Captain of the Wall Guards. **Orders**; **The Wall Does Not Fall:** Wall Guards and shieldbearers within 6" do not fall back and get +1 Nerve. **Weakness:** slow (5").

udesc:ottoman_regulars.en: The Ottomans: rank-and-file. Trench infantry in gas masks: rifle and bayonet, **Line**, **Gas Mask**. The backbone of the warband and its cheapest troops.

udesc:ottoman_thugs.en: The Ottomans: clubmen. Trench raiders: revolver, club and a sharpened trench spade, **Frenzy**, **Gas Mask**, **Trench Brawler** (+1 Melee in a trench). Made for night raids. **Weakness:** poor shots.

udesc:mehter_drummers.en: **Song** (allies within 6" get +1 Nerve, enemies −1 Melee); the sound of the drum drowns out the voice of the karakoncolos and of the Listeners. **Weakness:** poor fighters.

udesc:tulumbaci.en: **Digs Trenches**, **Fireproof**; they put out a fire marker in half a round. **Weakness:** one Wound.

udesc:shadow_players.en: Scouts, **Ambush**, **False Tracks** (tricks of the shadow theatre — once per battle the enemy fires at a false target). **Weakness:** light armour.

udesc:janissaries.en: **Volley** (Janissaries firing together at one target get +1 to shoot), **Line**; yatagan (2 Attacks). **Weakness:** middling armour; expensive infantry.

udesc:sipahis.en: Heavy cavalry (10"), **Charge**, **Trench-Breaker**. **Weakness:** a big target; slow in trenches.

udesc:night_watchmen.en: The city's night watchmen, who guard the streets with the knock of their staves. **Scout**, **Night-Eye**; **A Familiar Voice:** they do not trust the voice of the karakoncolos. **Weakness:** one Wound.

udesc:city_physicians.en: Physicians of the city hospital. **Healer**; they treat frostbite within 3". **Weakness:** they barely fight.

udesc:bastion_gunners.en: Heavy machine-guns of the city bastions. **Shield**, **Gas Mask**; their fire **pins**. **Weakness:** slow.

udesc:lantern_crawler.en: An armour-crawler lit by hundreds of lanterns, for the nights of the zemheri. **Vehicle**, **Beacon**; no night penalty within 12". **Weakness:** the lanterns give away ambushes — allied ones too.

udesc:city_wall_walker.en: A section of city wall on steam legs. **Walking Fortress**, **Fireproof**. **Weakness:** slow.

udesc:hero_elif.en: A calendar-maker's daughter, who counts the forty nights of the zemheri. **Orders**; **The Lost Night:** once per battle she restarts the round — every activation of that round is played again. **Weakness:** she barely fights.

udesc:hero_murat.en: Captain of the Tulumbacı, who meets the winter night with fire. **Orders**, **Fireproof**; **Ring of Fire:** once per battle karakoncolos cannot come within 6" for one round. **Weakness:** light armour.
